newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds calm as estimates cloud outlook.
newsitem.headline: European feeds calm as estimates cloud outlook.

text.p: European meals and feeds ended the week a little on the defensive on as buyers stayed largely absent with the near term clouded by the release of U.S. crop figures on Friday and more to come next week.
Traders said many physical buyers here were holding back purchases until the release of USDA U.S. crop data on Tuesday next week, particularly after the Leslie report on Friday.
"The market wasn't quite sure how to take it," one trader said. "The figures were up on the Sparks report but maybe not quite as high as some were predicting."
